services.desc: The House of Windsor has had a long love affair with the automobile. With King Edward VII's first "horseless carriage" purchase of a 1900 Daimler Mail Phaeton, the British Monarchy set in motion a new preferred method of royal transportation. From coach built Daimlers to Rolls Royce Phantoms, Land Rovers, Jaguars, Bentleys, MGs, Humbers and Aston Martins the British Monarchy has defined automotive style for over 120 years. This exhibit celebrates the British motorcar during this special Coronation year. Michael Schumacher was one of the greatest race car drivers of all time. His relationship with Ferrari and Formula One is one of legend. Come see one of our newest models, a 2001 Ferrari F1
